body:
More on Ooze, Crystal from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Ooze, Crystal (3pp)" but are not part of the Ooze, Crystal entry, which is unchanged.

Special Attacks constrict (1d6+4) 1d6+4, paralysis (3d6 rounds, DC 18)

TACTICS

A crystal ooze strikes by slamming into its opponents. Paralyzed victims are devoured.

Water Dependency (Ex)

Crystal oozes can survive out of the water for 1 hour per 4 points of Constitution and then begin to drown.

ECOLOGY

Environment any aquatic
Organization solitary
Treasure none

The crystal ooze is an aquatic variety of the gray ooze. It is semitransparent and clear and almost impossible to see in the water. The crystal ooze can grow to a length of up to 8 feet and a thickness of about 6 inches.
